name: bodachan sàbhail
text: Bodachan sàbhail is a Scottish Gaelic spirit of the barn. The name carries the sense of a sparing, thrifty little old man. The sprite pitied aged farmers and laboured on their behalf. He threshed their grain and eased the burden of the harvest.

attributes.attribute: Scottish Gaelic barn spirit who threshed grain for aged farmers
